basic_info.description: 2949-2951 Octavia Street is a 3,100 square foot two-unit multifamily property situated on a 2,450 square foot lot in Cow Hollow, one of San Francisco's most coveted neighborhoods known for its architectural charm and vibrant lifestyle. The property consists of two (2) spacious 2 BD / 1 BA units and three (3) parking spaces. Both units feature hardwood floors, bay windows, original wood detailing, generous natural light, and are individually metered for gas and electricity. Kitchens include gas stoves, dishwashers, and laminate tile countertops, while bathrooms offer pedestal sinks, hex tile flooring, and window ventilation. A shared backyard and in-unit laundry add to the appeal.     2949-2951 Octavia Street presents a rare opportunity for investors to acquire a classic San Francisco asset in a high-demand location. With one unit currently vacant and the other rented below market, the property offers significant upside potential through lease-up and rent optimization. Its prime location, timeless architecture, and income growth prospects make it an ideal investment for both immediate cash flow and long-term appreciation.
